business_scope.primary_industry_name: Carbon-Fiber Milling and Brushless Motor Integration of FPV Drones

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa (Apia; unitary national jurisdiction with no sub-state fiscal distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (English common-law heritage under the Judicature Ordinance 1961; customary law confined to land tenure outside commercial matters)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Island Countries Trade Agreement (PICTA) - active regional FTA
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus) - in force since 2020
Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters (OECD/Council of Europe) - in force for Samoa
Tax Information Exchange Agreements with major OECD partners, including Australia, New Zealand, the United States and Nordic states
No dedicated Samoa-People's Republic of China bilateral investment treaty in force; foreign investment protection is governed by Samoa's Foreign Investment Act 2000

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Countering Financing of Terrorism Act 2007 (as amended 2015, 2017 and 2019); Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2000; International Companies Act 2008 (as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Acts 2015 and 2016) requiring every international company to maintain a register of beneficial owners at its registered office and to file beneficial-ownership particulars with the Registrar; Samoa International Finance Authority Act 2001; SIFA AML/CFT Rules and Guidance binding on licensed registered agents; UN sanctions implementation legislation and applicable FATF Recommendations.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access - the register of beneficial owners is maintained by the licensed registered agent and filed with the Registrar and Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA); it is not open to public inspection and is disclosed only to competent supervisory, law-enforcement or tax authorities under the AML/CFT Act 2007, SIFA oversight powers and TIEA/MAC exchange channels.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true colour copy of passport of each UBO, director and shareholder (signature page certified)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public competent in the country of residence of the individual
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization - Samoa is not a contracting party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; the chain is notary certification, followed by the foreign ministry of the origin state and presentation at a Samoan embassy or honorary consulate; the licensed agent may provisionally accept a notarized set under SIFA CDD practice pending legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address of each UBO and director (utility bill or bank statement dated within three months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed bank in the jurisdiction of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (same chain as above); an apostille issued by an Apostille-contracting origin state is accepted as an evidentiary enhancement only

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter attesting to account conduct, good standing and source of wealth or funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Consular Legalization, or SWIFT-authenticated banker's letter accepted under the registered agent's risk-based CDD policy

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of incorporation documents and register of directors and shareholders of any corporate UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry in the corporate UBO's jurisdiction of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the origin state is a contracting party (evidentiary enhancement) or Consular Legalization where it is not; verified against the registered agent's CDD policy

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Chinese-English translation of UBO identification and address documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Certified translator endorsed by a notary public in the origin jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization chain: certified translator, notary, foreign ministry of the origin state, and Samoan consular authority

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-acceptance and continuous screening of each UBO, director, shareholder and officer against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, UK/EU consolidated sanctions and Samoa's domestic UN sanctions implementation list; mandatory PEP determination per FATF Recommendation 12 and the AML/CFT Act 2007 as amended, with enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth verification and senior-level approval for PEPs and high-risk source jurisdictions; adverse-media monitoring and ongoing transaction monitoring by the SIFA-licensed registered agent for the life of the company.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa Companies Registry (Registrar of Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour) and Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) licensed-agent submission channel; no public online name-search portal is available - name clearance is filed and monitored by the SIFA-licensed registered agent
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory name must be in Roman/Latin characters and end with a limited-liability suffix such as Limited, Corporation, Incorporated, Pty Limited, Ltd. or an abbreviation. A bilingual full-Chinese memorandum and articles of association are permitted with an English transcript filed, and an auxiliary Chinese name may be recorded in the memorandum and on the company seal; the certificate of incorporation reflects the English statutory name, and any Chinese alternate name is transliterated into pinyin for registry indexing.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Banking, Deposit or Deposit-taking - reserved to licensed financial institutions; requires Central Bank of Samoa consent
Trust, Trustee or Trustee Company - requires SIFA trust-licence consent
Insurance, Assurance or Reinsurance - requires insurance-regulator consent
Fund, Mutual Fund, Securities or Asset Management - requires securities-regulator consent
Government, Ministry, Authority, State or Samoa - implies official connection; prohibited
Royal or Imperial - implies royal patronage; prohibited
University, Institute or Chamber of Commerce - reserved; requires ministerial or professional-body consent
Names identical or nearly identical to an existing registered name, names contrary to public policy, indecent names, or names implying criminal activity - prohibited
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: On rejection, the licensed registered agent re-submits revised name options to the Registrar via SIFA; a written administrative request for reconsideration may be lodged through the agent within 14 days of the rejection notice, supported by consent or waiver letters where the objection concerns a sensitive token; if the Registrar maintains the refusal, judicial review lies to the Supreme Court of Samoa under the Judicature Ordinance 1961; each re-submission attracts the standard name-clearance tariff.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted for an International Company. A physical registered office in Samoa, being the licensed agent's premises in Apia, and a licensed registered agent are mandatory under the International Companies Act 2008; registers, seal and statutory records must be maintained there. ISIC 3240, being e-commerce retail of FPV racing drones, requires no separate industrial premises and no statutory operating licence; commercial substance is satisfied by the professional agent infrastructure and proper beneficial-ownership records.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for unannounced on-site inspection of the company itself, estimated at under 10% in year one for a low-risk standard retail profile; however, SIFA and the Registrar perform risk-based inspections of licensed agents' offices, including UBO files, CDD documentation and registered-office records, with periodic supervisory visits likely at the agent level; the registered agent conducts an annual compliance review in all cases.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrar of Companies / Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), filed via licensed registered agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations as amended

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation fee for an International Company with authorized capital of USD 1,000,000 or less

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff - SIFA International Companies Fee Schedule
Statutory annual tariff under the International Companies Act 2008

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: SIFA-licensed registered agent and registered office service for 12 months, including resident agent and company secretary
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market tariff under the registered-agent service agreement

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT customer due diligence, UBO register establishment, PEP/OFAC/UN sanctions screening and adverse-media checks
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: SIFA-licensed registered agent / AML compliance officer
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark fee reflecting mandatory CDD obligations under the AML/CFT Act 2007

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, certified Chinese-English translation and consular legalization of UBO identification and address documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and foreign-ministry / Samoan consular authorities in the origin jurisdiction
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing notarial and consular tariff in the origin jurisdiction (reimbursable disbursement)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of bilingual English/Chinese memorandum and articles of association, company seal and issuance of share certificates
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed registered agent / corporate legal counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed market fee for standard-documentation suite

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Courier dispatch of original legalized documents and bank reference letter
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Actual disbursement at prevailing courier tariff

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2008, principally ss. 6–8 (incorporation, constitution and corporate name), ss. 10–11 (registered office and registered agent) and Schedule 2 (fees)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), International Companies Registry, Apia, Samoa — the statutory regulator of Samoa's international financial services sector
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (Constitutional Documents) accompanied by a Statement of Compliance, lodged with SIFA for registration and resulting in the issuance of a Certificate of Incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital and no escrow requirement apply to a Samoan International Company. Shares may be issued with or without par value and in any currency; the pro-forma first allotment is one (1) ordinary share to the initial subscriber.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, unanimously, by the subscribers as first directors, that the Memorandum and Articles of Association signed and lodged with the Samoa International Finance Authority be confirmed and adopted. RESOLVED FURTHER that the Company accept the subscription and allot to the subscriber identified in the Articles one (1) fully paid ordinary share without par value. RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office of the Company be the office address of its licensed registered agent in Apia, Samoa. RESOLVED FURTHER that [Name] be appointed President, [Name] Secretary and [Name] Treasurer, each with authority to open bank accounts, execute agreements, and perfect all statutory filings required to commence business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), International Companies Registry, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request to SIFA covering up to three proposed names for the FPV racing drone company. SIFA verifies that the selected name is not identical or misleadingly similar to an existing registered international or domestic company, contains no prohibited words, and is not contrary to the public interest. A name in English, Chinese, or other Roman-script language may be used; a Chinese-language name may be adopted as a secondary registered name. Upon approval, the name is reserved for the applicant for a defined reservation period.
required_dossiers: SIFA Name Reservation Request Form
Certified copy of subscriber's valid passport or national identity document
Signed engagement letter from a SIFA-licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused, file a revised reservation with alternative names or submit a written appeal to SIFA demonstrating that the name is sufficiently distinctive and does not create confusion with a protected or identical existing name.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFA-licensed registered agent and notary public in Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent prepares the Memorandum and Articles of Association in the English language with an optional certified Chinese translation annexed. The subscriber executes the documents before a notary public, with signatures witnessed and notarially certified. The agent completes a Statement of Compliance confirming that all requirements of the International Companies Act 1987 have been met and that the company will not carry on business with the public in Samoa without a separate domestic licence.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association (three counterparts)
Signed Statement of Compliance by the registered agent
Notarized consents of the subscriber and first director(s)
Certified identification documents of the subscriber and first director(s)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The registered agent corrects any drafting defects, obtains re-execution of signatures, and re-notarizes the documents before lodgment; no additional government fee applies if correction is completed prior to submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Lodgment and Government Fee Payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), International Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, Statement of Compliance, consents of the registered agent and first director(s), and the prescribed incorporation fee of US$500 together with the prorated first annual licence fee. SIFA examines the documents for compliance with the International Companies Act 1987, registers the company upon full satisfaction, and allocates a unique company registration number.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association
Statement of Compliance
Consent to Act as Registered Agent
Consent to Act as Director
Confirmation of Registered Office Address
Payment receipt for government filing fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SIFA issues a query notice, the registered agent files a responsive statement or amended document within fourteen days; unresolved queries may be cured by fresh lodgment and, where appropriate, an application for SIFA administrative reconsideration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), International Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon successful registration, SIFA issues the Certificate of Incorporation evidencing that the company is duly incorporated with limited liability from the date of registration. The certificate states the company name, registration number, and date of incorporation. The registered agent retains the certificate, adopts the registered office in Apia for service of process, and opens the statutory corporate registers.
required_dossiers: SIFA Certificate of Incorporation
Notice of Registered Office
Corporate registers (share register, register of directors, register of officers)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains any error in the company name, number, or date, the registered agent applies to SIFA for a corrected certificate; SIFA verifies the registry record and reissues the certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Resolutions, Share Allotment and Officer Appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the Company; minutes and registers maintained by the SIFA-licensed registered agent in Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first meeting of directors or execute a written unanimous resolution adopting the pro-forma First Board Resolution confirming the Constitutional Documents, approving the allotment of one ordinary share to the initial subscriber, confirming the registered office and registered agent, and appointing the President, Secretary and Treasurer. The board then approves the corporate banking mandate and authorized signatories and records the allotment in the statutory share register.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the first directors' meeting or written unanimous resolution
Share allotment ledger
Register of directors and officers
Bank account opening forms and signatory mandate
Board resolution authorizing banking and contract execution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any omission in the allotment or appointments is cured by a subsequent unanimous board resolution ratifying the prior act; corrected minutes and registers are filed with the registered agent and, where applicable, a notice of change is lodged with SIFA.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) — Industrial Operations Division, acting in coordination with the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) for international company status
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: MCIL Industrial Premises Operating Clearance for Carbon-Fiber Milling and Brushless Motor Integration, together with PUMA Development Consent for industrial land use

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA), Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Independent State of Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B — Mandatory Initial Environmental Examination (IEE) for light industrial manufacturing; a full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) is required only where the site adjoins sensitive receptors, wetlands, or residential zones
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge limited to BOD 30 mg/L and TSS 50 mg/L under a Water Resources Management Act 2008 discharge permit; particulate emissions controlled by HEPA-filtered dust extraction on CNC milling stations; carbon-fiber dust managed as a hazardous waste stream under the Waste Management Act 2011 with licensed off-site disposal; volatile organic compounds (VOCs) from adhesives and coatings kept below national ambient air standards; continuous acoustic and dust records maintained on site; waste manifesting and spill response plan required.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA) verifying means of egress, working fire suppression systems, and safe storage of flammable resins and lithium polymer batteries; Structural Load Approval from the Ministry of Works, Transport and Infrastructure (MWTI) covering floor loading of milling machinery and mezzanine storage; Workplace Occupational Safety and Health clearance from the MCIL OSH Division covering machine guarding, personal protective equipment, electrical safety, and operator noise exposure not exceeding 85 dB(A) time-weighted average.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA), Ministry for Revenue, online portal at https://www.revenue.gov.ws/ (SRA Online Services). Incorporation and annual licensing of International Companies are administered jointly with the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) under the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a non-resident-owned International Company (IC), Step 1 is incorporation through a licensed Samoan registered agent or SIFA, producing the Certificate of Incorporation and the IC registration number. Step 2 is application to the SRA for a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) via the SRA registration form (IR-1) at the SRA One-Stop Shop, submitting the Certificate of Incorporation, the statutory tax exemption certificate issued under the International Companies Act 1987, and proof of the registered agent address. Step 3 is issuance by the SRA of the TIN and, where the IC undertakes domestic supply, a separate Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST) registration certificate. Standard ICs are granted a 20-year tax exemption certificate and are excluded from the resident VAGST registration base for offshore business.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: International Companies enjoy a statutory exemption from Samoan income tax, VAGST, stamp duty on offshore transactions, and withholding tax on distributions to non-residents, provided the IC does not carry on domestic business in Samoa. The exemption is ring-fenced; any local Samoan-source trading activity converts the relevant income to a taxable resident status.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Samoa does not operate a US-style check-the-box election. An IC may file the statutory exemption certificate with SRA and, if it inadvertently engages in domestic trade, may elect to be treated as an ordinary resident company under the Income Tax Act 2012, which revokes the IC exemption for the domestic business segment. Hybrid mismatch elections are not legislated; however, SIFA administers elective exchange-of-information and treaty-compatible classification forms for ICs seeking to be recognized as non-resident tax-transparent vehicles in foreign jurisdictions.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST) imposed under the VAGST Act 1997; the standard rate has been 15% historically, with a legislated increase to 17.5% announced for 1 July 2025, requiring rate verification at the time of invoicing.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 annual taxable turnover (VAGST Act 1997) for compulsory registration; suppliers below the threshold may voluntarily register; the SRA may compel registration for any person making taxable supplies in the course of a taxable activity in Samoa.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API-based e-invoicing, or digital stamping mandate is in force in Samoa. VAGST-registered suppliers must issue a tax invoice containing prescribed particulars: supplier name and TIN, purchaser name and TIN, description of supply, taxable amount, and VAGST charged. Electronic returns and payments are lodged through SRA Online Services; the SRA applies risk-based audit selection and data-matching rather than mandatory pre-clearance of invoices. Digital record-keeping is mandatory for VAGST-registered persons.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies under section 16(1)(a) of the VAGST Act 1997 to goods physically exported from Samoa, provided the supplier exports the goods within 28 days of sale or within any further period approved by the SRA, and to services supplied to a non-resident who is outside Samoa at the time of supply where the benefit of the services is not enjoyed in Samoa. The IC's FPV racing drone retail sales to overseas buyers qualify for zero-rating where the drones leave Samoa through Apia port or Faleolo International Airport and the supplier retains contemporaneous export evidence; input VAGST attributable to zero-rated supplies is refundable to the exporter.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (electronic entry-outward lodged with the Samoa Customs Division of the SRA) with the unique export reference number and commercial invoice
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical departure from Samoa, plus courier tracking logs (DHL/FedEx/UPS) showing foreign delivery
Bank Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT MT103 confirmation evidencing settlement in foreign currency, and payment gateway settlement reports from PayPal and Stripe
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating claims are reviewed by SRA audit with retrospective reassessment and clawback of output VAGST if the documented export, payment, or 180-day currency repatriation trail is defective. Penalties include a late payment penalty of 2% per month on the assessed amount, a civil penalty of up to 150% of the tax shortfall for false or misleading export declarations, and criminal sanctions of fines and imprisonment for fraudulent zero-rating claims. All export documentation and underlying FX evidence must be retained for at least seven years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoa Tala (WST) is a non-internationally-traded currency administered by the Central Bank of Samoa under a managed float referenced to a currency basket (USD, NZD, AUD, EUR, JPY, CNY). Current-account transactions (trade, services, remittances) are liberalized under the Exchange Control Regulations 2016 but must be routed through an authorized dealer bank with full supporting documentation at the point of execution. Capital-account transactions, including foreign direct investment, equity injections, and dividend remittances, remain subject to Central Bank of Samoa notification/approval thresholds and are policed by authorized dealers through prescribed exchange-control reporting forms. The WS_IC International Company is a non-resident entity under the International Companies Act 2018: it must not carry on business in Samoa, must transact exclusively in foreign currencies, and sits outside the domestic convertibility and surrender regime. Profit remittance analysis: dividends paid by the tax-exempt IC to non-resident shareholders are free of Samoa withholding tax and are remittable via SWIFT MT103 without Central Bank approval, provided (i) remittance is made from a foreign-currency account, (ii) the paying authorized dealer verifies the IC's Certificate of Good Standing and the registered agent's certification, and (iii) the payment narrative carries the BPM6 purpose code D210 (dividends). Practical hurdle: authorized dealers will not convert WST for non-resident ICs, and a domestic WST settlement by the IC would trigger residence reclassification risk; the treasury architecture must therefore remain 100% USD-denominated.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For resident Samoan exporters, Regulation 7 of the Exchange Control Regulations 1982 (as amended in 2016) requires that all export proceeds be repatriated to Samoa through an authorized dealer and sold for WST within one month from the date of exportation unless a written exemption is obtained from the Central Bank. Traditional commodity exporters generally cannot retain foreign currency; non-traditional exporters may apply through their bank for approval to retain foreign-currency proceeds in an authorized-dealer account for working-capital purposes, subject to quarterly Central Bank reporting. For the WS_IC FPV drone treasury blueprint, the surrender rules are NOT triggered: the IC is a non-resident company, it does not export physical goods from Samoan customs territory (components are milled and integrated by contract manufacturers in China/Southeast Asia and shipped directly to end customers), and it holds no WST-denominated accounts. Critical compliance precondition: no Samoan customs export declaration may be made in the IC's name, retail proceeds (PayPal/Stripe) must never be converted into WST, and all settlement must remain in USD foreign-currency accounts at an authorized dealer so the Central Bank of Samoa continues to treat the entity as non-resident.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Multi-currency non-resident Corporate Operational Account (USD) with global SWIFT clearing and trade finance desk
Foreign-Currency Corporate Account (USD) with Pacific regional clearing, PayPal sweep capability, and commercial LC issuance
Capital Escrow / Foreign-Currency Account (USD) - state-owned institution with conservative compliance appetite and limited international banking product set

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium as a collections and disbursement adjunct; Low as a standalone core treasury bank. Legal constraints: offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Mercury, Airwallex, Payoneer, Currencycloud) are not licensed or supervised by the Central Bank of Samoa; balances held with them are unregulated custodial balances in Samoan regulatory terms, and the IC's registered agent and Samoan auditor must still reconcile all treasury movements to the authorized-dealer account. PayPal is available to Samoa-registered entities for receiving retail card payments and supports payouts to a Samoan bank USD account, but Stripe is NOT a supported acquiring market in Samoa; therefore the WS_IC must contract Stripe through a payment facilitator or a sister acquiring entity in a supported jurisdiction (US, Singapore, or Hong Kong), with net proceeds escalated to the tier-1 Samoan USD account via MT103. EMI architecture rule: use Airwallex (HK) or Mercury (US) only as a collection-side aggregator with a hard daily sweep policy to the ANZ/BSP Samoa USD account, so that the audit trail, Central Bank exchange-control filing trail, and registered-agent oversight remain intact and no more than a small operating float (under USD 25,000) is ever left offshore.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote opening is available in principle but is conditioned on the licensed Samoa registered agent (an international company service provider supervised under the International Companies Act 2018 and the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007) submitting a certified CDD/KYC bundle, and on the bank conducting a live video KYC interview with each director and ultimate beneficial owner. In practice, ANZ Bank (Samoa) Ltd and BSP (Samoa) Ltd will waive physical attendance where: (i) passports are notarized and apostilled, (ii) the registered agent signs the bank's Know Your Business certificate, (iii) wet-ink board resolutions and signed account mandates are couriered to the bank, and (iv) the first capital credit originates from the UBO's own verified bank account. Bank of Samoa generally requires at least one physical appearance of the signatory for a first-time non-resident International Company. Physical presence cannot substitute for the statutory requirement that the IC maintain a registered office and licensed registered agent in Samoa; the survey of the account mandate must always be countersigned by that agent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity, nominee arrangements, or undisclosed economic interest held by third-country tax residents
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: MCIL Commercial Registry-verified Certificate of Incorporation; Certificate of Good Standing; full UBO declaration and 25%+ attestation forms; the registered agent's licensed due-diligence file; notarized/apostilled passports and source-of-address proofs for each natural-person UBO; source-of-funds and source-of-wealth letters with 12-month personal bank statements; negative-media and PEP screening reports dated within 90 days.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Business profile mismatch: a Samoa International Company with no local office or staff generating global e-commerce drone revenues through PayPal/Stripe at high velocity and low ticket size
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Business plan and operating memorandum for FPV racing drone retail under ISIC 3240; Shopify/Amazon/e-commerce storefront links and SKU lists; contract manufacturing and supply-chain agreements for carbon-fiber milling and brushless motor integration in China/Southeast Asia; customs declarations, bills of lading, and airway bills for fulfillment shipments; PayPal/Stripe settlement reports and merchant identification certificates; prior operational history if the entity migrated from another jurisdiction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume micro-payment pattern, person-to-person style incoming transfers, or suspected card fraud, third-party collection, or crypto-linked channels
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Platform-generated transaction history with customer geographic distribution; refund and chargeback policy artifacts; API/aggregator statements mapping gross settlement amounts to invoice numbers; a signed AML compliance undertaking confirming that no personal accounts, crypto exchange accounts, or third-party omnibus accounts will be used; internally prepared 12-month accounting ledger or unaudited financial statements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or high-risk jurisdiction exposure: counterparties in restricted territories or named banks, or beneficial owners holding citizenship of sanctioned states
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions and adverse-media screening outputs covering customers, suppliers, banks, and freight-forwarding entities; OFAC/UN/EU list verification of the full counterparty book; a destination-country justification memorandum; where a sanctioned link appears, a sworn attestation of immediate counterparty termination and a remediation plan acceptable to the bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border wires without matching trade documentation, including undocumented capital flows and invoice mismatches
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Invoice packets and purchase orders tied to each wire with PO reference in the MT103 narrative field; proforma invoices for component imports; warehouse and fulfillment agreements; share subscription agreements, board minutes, and register-of-members extracts for equity injections; completed Central Bank of Samoa exchange-control declarations prepared by the authorized dealer.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: the UBO holds a personal or corporate account at a well-rated bank in the UBO's home jurisdiction. Injection is executed by SWIFT MT103/202 to the WS_IC's USD account at ANZ or BSP Samoa (authorized dealer), with beneficiary exactly as 'WS_IC' and narrative 'Subscription for shares in Samoa International Company - direct investment equity capital (BPM6 code S101)'. Pre-clearance: the registered agent submits to the receiving bank the board minute allotting shares, the signed share subscription agreement, the updated register of members, and the share-capital ledger entry; the bank completes the Central Bank exchange-control notification and escalates for any approval where the transaction exceeds the per-transfer threshold for capital inflows. Enforcement protocol: (i) no cash deposits, bearer instruments, or crypto-to-fiat bridging; (ii) the remitter must be the named UBO or a holding entity documented in the UBO chain - third-party funding is rejected outright; (iii) the first credit is accepted only after account sign-off and a successful test wire; (iv) every capital credit must be mirrored in the IC's capital ledger and disclosed to the auditor to preserve the tax-exempt non-resident status.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Retail settlement rails: (a) PayPal sweep - the PayPal USD balance is auto-swept at daily or weekly thresholds to the ANZ/BSP Samoa USD account through the platform's standard withdrawal rail; (b) Stripe (available only via the supported sister entity or payment facilitator) - payouts land in the sister entity's US bank account via US ACH, then are escalated via SWIFT MT103 to the Samoa tier-1 USD account. Supplier payment rails: (a) SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers from the tier-1 Samoan USD account directly to Chinese component suppliers, with the remitter name 'WS_IC', the supplier's invoice number, and the PO number in the narrative field; (b) for bulk brushless-motor, carbon-fiber prepreg, and electronics purchases, an irrevocable documentary commercial letter of credit (sight or 30/60/90-day usance) issued by ANZ/BSP for the account of WS_IC, supported by the supplier proforma invoice, transport documents, inspection certificates, and customs clearance of the shipment country; (c) treasury desk execution - matched USD/CNY spot conversions for milestone payments only when a committed payable exists. Cost and limit assumptions: MT103 fees average USD 25-40 per leg; letters of credit require 100-110% cash cover or a sanctioned credit facility for at least the first 12 months; a minimum operating float of USD 50,000 must be maintained in the Samoan account to avoid service downgrade, and sub-account sweeps must never violate the authorized-dealer-only rule.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/CNY forward contracts with ANZ Bank (Samoa) Ltd or BSP (Samoa) Ltd treasury desks, limited to the firm trade-payables book with maximum twelve-month tenor and authorized-dealer reporting to the Central Bank of Samoa

USD/CNH non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) executed through an approved offshore treasury desk (Airwallex, Currencycloud, or a prime international bank) for CNY exposure that cannot be settled deliverably offshore

USD/WST outright forwards via a Samoan authorized dealer, permitted only for the IC's incidental Samoan operating costs (registered agent fees, government filing fees, and statutory charges) since WST is not deliverable offshore

Cross-currency swaps (USD floating versus CNY fixed) with an approved global dealer bank where annual supply-chain payables exceed USD 2,000,000, subject to prior Central Bank of Samoa notification and a board resolution evidencing the hedging intent

Plain-vanilla FX call and put options via a global dealing bank, non-deliverable where the reference currency is CNY or WST, permitted strictly for hedging committed commercial exposures and prohibited for speculative trading

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government License Fee (Annual Certificate of Good Standing) for International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) / Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on the anniversary date of incorporation; payment must be received by SIFA no later than 30 days after the anniversary to maintain good standing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late payment surcharge of 10% of the annual fee applies after the anniversary; continued non-payment for 6 months from the anniversary leads to administrative strike-off and dissolution of the company under the International Companies Act 1987. Reinstatement, if available, requires payment of all arrears plus a reinstatement fee.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (Form 5D / Annual Return under International Companies Act 1987, s.120)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filing must be completed within 30 calendar days following the incorporation anniversary date each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A penalty of WST 20 (approx. USD 7) per month or part thereof is imposed for late filing, subject to a maximum penalty of WST 120 (approx. USD 44); failure to file for 3 consecutive years exposes the company to administrative strike-off notice and deregistration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Annual Confirmation (integrated with Annual Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies via the licensed Registered Agent (SIFA portal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must accompany and be submitted together with the Annual Return within 30 days of the incorporation anniversary; any change in beneficial ownership during the year must be reported within the same annual filing window
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No separate late fee; non-filing is treated as non-compliance with the Annual Return, triggering per-month penalties and ultimate strike-off. Knowingly providing false UBO information is an offense punishable by a fine of up to WST 5,000 (approx. USD 1,850) and/or imprisonment.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Samoa International Company is entirely exempt from the statutory audit requirement and from the filing of audited financial statements with the Registrar, unless (i) the company is licensed under the International Financial Services Act 2001, (ii) the company undertakes trust, banking, insurance, or digital asset activities requiring a financial services license, or (iii) an express audit requirement is imposed by its Memorandum and Articles of Association. For a standard FPV racing drone retail IC structured as a tax-exempt offshore holding/sales vehicle, no compulsory audit applies.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS or Samoan Local GAAP; however, the International Companies Act 1987 requires only the maintenance of records sufficient to reflect financial position. If audited statements are voluntarily prepared, they should be prepared under IFRS. No financial statements are required to be lodged with the Registrar.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed Registered Agent must maintain the Beneficial Ownership Register and confirm annually, during the Annual Return cycle, the names, dates of birth, nationalities, residential addresses, and nature/percentage of control of each individual who ultimately owns or controls more than 25% of the International Company's shares or voting rights. Any share transfer during the year must be recorded in the Register of Members first, with the UBO register updated within 14 days of such transfer being recorded; the annual confirmation then ratifies the UBO status as of the anniversary date.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book (minutes of directors' and members' resolutions)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,200 - USD 2,500 (includes Samoa licensed registered agent, registered office, SIFA liaison, and annual compliance coordination)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 - USD 6,500 (only if triggered by licensing, banking activity, or voluntary audit; a standard exempt IC generally incurs zero audit cost)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 27% (Income Tax Act 2012, operative rate for resident companies)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies (ICs) are classified as tax-exempt bodies: 0% Samoa income tax on non-Samoa-source income for a 20-year exemption window from incorporation (renewable), no capital gains tax, no stamp duty on IC instruments, and no exit charge on foreign-source assets; the statutory exemption is conditional on the IC not conducting business in Samoa and having no Samoa-source income.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Return under Section 132, International Companies Act 1987 (as amended); electronic lodgment is accepted through the Samoa International Companies Registry under the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, with licensed registered agents as mandatory intermediaries; no corporate income tax form applies to a tax-exempt IC unless the exemption is lost, in which case Form CIR-2 (Annual Tax Return) is filed with the Samoa Inland Revenue Department (IRD).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days after the anniversary date of incorporation; the annual enfranchisement fee must be settled before the return is accepted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered corporate name, incorporation number, date of incorporation and jurisdiction of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the exact English name as registered; no translation is accepted; confirm the IC number evidenced by the Certificate of Incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 - Registered Office and Registered Agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical address of the registered office in Samoa and full name and licence number of the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders cannot lodge a registered office; the address must be the licensed agent's office in Apia maintained under Section 118 of the Act.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full name, residential or business address, nationality, date of birth and passport number of each director; minimum of one director, natural persons or corporate directors permitted.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are expressly allowed; provide notarised copies of photo identification; no Samoan residency requirement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and address of the corporate or individual secretary; appointment is optional but the registered agent frequently serves as secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident secretary may be appointed; a licensed Samoa registered agent must still be retained for the registered office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Beneficial shareholder names, number and class of shares, share premium, and dates of allotment; bearer shares are prohibited.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: 100% non-resident ownership is permitted; disclose ultimate beneficial owners to the registered agent for AML/CFT customer due diligence; retain beneficial ownership register entries.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 - Share Capital and Solvency Declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and paid-up capital; statutory minimum paid-up capital is not required but directors must confirm solvency to trade an FPV drones retail business.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State share amounts in U.S. dollars; a declaration that the IC is solvent or will not incur debts beyond its ability to pay is signed by a director.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of principal objects and confirmation that no business is conducted inside Samoa.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Describe fully the ISIC 3240 activities (carbon-fiber milling, brushless motor integration, FPV racing drone retail) as strictly offshore e-commerce through PayPal and Stripe; this preserves the 0% tax-exempt status.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Self-verification that the IC has not derived Samoa-source income and is eligible for the International Company tax exemption.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Retain supporting evidence (supply agreements, bank statements, customs declarations) to disprove any Samoa-source trade; false certification exposes directors to penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registration of mortgages, charges and other security instruments affecting IC assets.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Register any charge within 28 days of creation; unlodged charges are void against a liquidator or creditor.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature of a director or secretary, date, and confirmation of the truth and completeness of the return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Telephonic, digital or faxed signature accepted by the registered agent; the person signing assumes personal responsibility for false statements.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late annual return: penalty of WST 150 for the first month of default plus WST 100 for each subsequent month or part month; continued default attracts administrative strike-off from the register, loss of corporate personality, and reinstatement only through a court order and payment of all arrears; the licence of a defaulting registered agent may also be suspended.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% on distributions by a tax-exempt International Company: the IC's profits are exempt, so dividends paid to non-resident shareholders are neither Samoan-source income nor subject to withholding. The general statutory non-resident dividend WHT rate under the Income Tax Act 2012 is 15%, applied only where a company earns Samoa-source income.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Where treaty relief is sought (non-IC residents claiming Samoa treaty benefits or IC signatories invoking a DTA), the creditor must: (i) obtain an official Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the domestic tax authority; (ii) complete the IRD withholding tax exemption form (IRD Form 6/WHT Variation) and attach the TRC and DTA claim details; (iii) submit the documents to the Samoan payer before crediting or payment; (iv) receive written IRD approval before the payer may apply the reduced treaty rate; and (v) apply for a refund of any over-withheld tax through the IRD within the applicable 4-year limitation period.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory non-resident WHT in Samoa: interest at 10%, royalties at 15% (Income Tax Act 2012, s. 88); under Samoa's limited DTA network (Australia, New Zealand, Norway, United Kingdom, Sweden), royalties and interest rates are generally reduced (typically 0-10% for interest and 0-15% for royalties, subject to beneficial ownership conditions); payments by an IC to an offshore licensor or lender are external obligations with no Samoan WHT conduit because the IC has no Samoa-source character.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory quantitative threshold is codified in Samoa's Income Tax Act 2012; the Commissioner may issue transfer pricing adjustments on any cross-border related-party transaction that does not satisfy the arm's length standard. Administrative best practice for an IC with annual foreign related-party turnover above WST 1,000,000 is to maintain a contemporaneous Local File, Master File and, where group turnover exceeds EUR 750 million, a Country-by-Country Report in line with OECD Chapter V; documentation must be produced within 30 days of an IRD request.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Companies (Economic Substance) Regulations 2019/2020, enacted in response to EU Code of Conduct Group harmful tax practices work, require an IC carrying on a relevant activity to maintain in Samoa: (i) direction and management exercised locally, (ii) adequate employees in Samoa, (iii) adequate physical premises, and (iv) core income-generating activities performed in Samoa. The FPV racing drone retail chain (carbon-fiber milling, motor integration, and e-commerce distribution) falls within distribution and retail; if marketed as tax-exempt offshore, it must be supported by real substance. A pure post-box IC is a compliance nullity and risks reassessment, penalties and exchange-of-information disclosure.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately certifying the annual return tax-exemption declaration while operating inside Samoa, transacting with Samoan customers, receiving funds into Samoan bank accounts, or maintaining Samoan inventory without declaring Samoa-source income to the IRD.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil penalty of 150% of the tax evaded, daily default interest, and criminal fine up to WST 10,000 per offence or imprisonment up to 2 years (Income Tax Act 2012 ss. 129-131, 140); the tax-exempt IC status is revoked with retroactive effect and a 27% CIT charge is applied on the full income stream.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for the company's unpaid tax where evasion is attributable to their wilful act or default; personal bank accounts and offshore assets may be seized, exit clearance and travel bans imposed, and imprisonment applied against the exposing or beneficial owner.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using a nominal Apia registered-agent address with no local management, no local employees, no board meetings and no inventory in Samoa, while presenting the IC as a tax-free e-commerce seller of FPV drones to evade home-jurisdiction tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recharacterisation of the IC as a sham under anti-avoidance powers; strike-off under the International Companies Act; automatic exchange of beneficial ownership information to resident-tax authorities; penalty of up to WST 300,000 or 3 times the tax benefit, and closure of the entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and controlling shareholders lose limited-liability protection for debts of the shell; courts pierce the corporate veil to order civil restitution from personal assets, impose travel bans while investigations are pending, and may pursue extradition or prosecution in OECD jurisdictions cooperating with Samoa.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to identify beneficial owners, failing to appoint a compliance officer, omitting suspicious transaction reports for PayPal or Stripe credit-card inflows, or using the IC to conceal assets from a foreign court or tax administration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime Act 2007 and the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2018, corporate fines up to WST 7,000,000 (or twice the benefit), natural-person fines up to WST 500,000 and imprisonment up to 10 years; administrative deregistration and freezing orders on Samoan accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers face personal criminal prosecution, disqualification from acting as directors for up to 10 years, confiscation of unexplained wealth under proceeds-of-crime powers, and travel bans; the registered agent may be separately sanctioned for deficient AML procedures.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file the IC annual return within 30 days of the anniversary, permitting the registered agent's licence to lapse, or continuing to trade after the Registrar's strike-off notice.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monetary penalties of WST 150 (first month) plus WST 100 per subsequent month of default; automatic strike-off and dissolution after 6 months in default; forfeiture of assets to the Registrar available for collection; reinstatement requires a Supreme Court order, all arrears, and a new registered agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who trade under a struck-off IC are personally liable for all debts contracted after dissolution, subject to damages for fraudulent trading, disqualification orders, and exclusion from future Samoan incorporations; travel bans may be imposed to secure the restitution of seized assets.
